trials.instruction: Lift the payment sign with angled face from the table and rotate it so the code faces you.
Use the left arm to pick the sign with yellow payment section and turn it towards you.
Use the left arm to grab the plastic smooth paymentsign and rotate QR code towards you.
Catch the beige paymentsign with printed details with the left arm, then rotate it to make the QR code visible.
Take the rectangular paymentsign with colorful top, raise it, and make the qrcode face you.
Use the left arm to grab the small paymentsign for mobile payments and rotate it until the QR faces forward
Catch the tabletop-sized payment sign, lift it, and turn the qrcode towards you.
Lift the small payment stand with black base from the surface and adjust its angle towards you
Slide the smooth plastic paymentsign with QR code off the table and turn it to face you.
Grab the paymentsign with glossy blue panel with the right arm, then rotate it to face yourself.
